record.body:
## Description

Replace the Needs you Static with a focusable list. n focuses it and esc returns to the task table. enter opens the task detail when the item has a task, else a Needs-you detail screen with the record type, full text and body. c copies the subject. Waits on needs-you-records for the item fields.

payload.title: Make Needs you a selectable list with a detail screen

record.subject: needs-you-list
